subject: pclxs: ref_target must be identity-stable and referent-true (contract note)
description: PCL's ref_target returned the ref WRAPPER, not the referent, so magic_set and magic_get keyed different identities. Magic is the first consumer that notices (blessing survived it via a fallback arm). State the requirement in pclxs_host.h at ref_target and in docs/porting-a-host.md.
